## Product Description

The Sunstride Rollator from Vive Mobility embodies mobility and versatility. Our 4-wheeled walker assists you through almost any terrain, it also provides a comfortable place to sit if you need to rest. This mobility aid is designed for elderly individuals and people with walking disabilities. The wheels help the walker glide smoothly across a variety of terrains and the padded seat helps to rest anytime you need to. 

This walker is designed with a lightweight yet strong aluminum alloy frame, which is also designed to prevent corrosion. This walker also supports a weight of 300 lbs. without affecting opposability. This incorporates ergonomic dual brakes that can automatically be controlled during breaks and a locked brake system, which facilitates rest on inclined terrain. This enhanced rest brake system supports a walker with a pad. You can store and transport it with ease. Simply fold it down to fit perfectly in your car trunk or to compact spaces. The detachable storage bag holds purses, wallets, electronics, meds and essentials so you can access them during your activities. Whether you’re shopping, exercising, or doing other daily activities, the Sunstride will provide dependable support to help you stay confident and maintain your independence throughout the day. 

## Features

- Stable All-Terrain Support: Confidently navigate most surfaces with reliable mobility support, comfortable rest seating and safe storage for daily essentials
- Customizable Handle Height: Easily adjust handle height in 1-inch increments (31"-36") for comfortable ergonomic fit for any individual
- Compact Foldable Frame: Conveniently folds to 10" x 20" x 32" for easy storage and transportation, fitting in car trunks effortlessly
- Dual Safety Braking: Ergonomic hand brakes safely maneuver inclines while secure wheel locks provide added stability when seated
- Lightweight Durable Construction: Corrosion-resistant aluminum frame supports up to 300 pounds while remaining easy to maneuver
- Detachable Storage Bag: Removable 15" x 13" x 3.5" bag safely stores purse, wallet, electronics, medications and personal items

## FAQ

#### Does it come pre-assembled?

Yes, the rollator is pre-assembled, needing only the front wheels to be snapped into place before use.

#### Do you have to remove the wheels to fold it?

Although the front wheels can be removed for more compact storage, it is not necessary to remove them before folding the rollator.

#### Will a rollator be good for someone with knee pain?

Yes, the rollator provides support for those with limited mobility, relieving pressure on the knees.

#### Can it be easily folded to take in a car?

Yes, to fold the rollator, simply pull upward on the center strap. The front wheels can also be removed with the push pins for more compact storage.

#### Is The Sunstride Rollator height adjustable?

Yes! The handle height can be adjusted in one-inch increments from 31” to 36”.

#### What is the weight limit for the rollator?

The rollator safely supports up to 300 pounds.

#### How wide is the Sunstride Rollator?

The rollator is 25” wide.

#### Will the hand brakes be easy to use for someone with arthritis?

Yes, the hand brakes are designed for easy use.

#### How much does the rollator weigh?

The rollator weight 20 pounds.

#### Can I lock the wheels when resting on the seat?

Yes, the back wheels lock in place for extra stability when seated.

Discover a New Way to Move: The SunStride Rollator Walker by Vive

Whether you're navigating the comfort of your home or stepping out to enjoy the fresh air, mobility should feel empowering—not limiting. That’s the promise behind the beautifully engineered SunStride Rollator Walker by Vive, a sleek, stylish, and supportive mobility solution designed for today’s active lifestyle.

More than just a walker, the SunStride is a thoughtfully crafted rollator that blends security, storage, and sophistication into one compact, high-performing design. It’s time to rediscover your independence—with every step you take.

### Smooth, Stable, and Built for the Journey

At the heart of the SunStride Rollator’s superior performance is its oversized all-terrain wheels, purpose-built to handle a wide range of surfaces. From hardwood floors to bumpy sidewalks, the SunStride glides effortlessly and silently, making your daily routes feel smoother and more enjoyable. Whether indoors or outdoors, this rollator offers the kind of reliability and control that turns hesitant steps into confident strides.

The dual braking system ensures you’re always in control. Simple hand brakes allow you to slow down or stop completely with minimal effort. And when you’re ready to rest, the brakes lock firmly into place—so you can sit securely on the built-in seat without worrying about rolling or tipping.

### Compact Convenience for Life on the Move

Designed for real-world living, the SunStride Rollator features an ingenious foldable frame with hinged and removable wheels, making it easier than ever to transport and store. Whether you’re sliding it into the backseat, tucking it into a closet, or maneuvering through tight doorways, the SunStride adapts to your space—not the other way around.

Despite its lightweight frame, the rollator doesn’t compromise on strength or stability. The sturdy aluminum build supports users confidently while maintaining a modern, minimal look that doesn’t scream “medical device.”

### Storage That Goes Where You Go

Function meets fashion with the SunStride’s integrated storage options. Say goodbye to juggling bags or stuffing your pockets—this rollator keeps everything you need right at your fingertips. A spacious under-seat storage bag discreetly holds larger items like books, water bottles, or snacks, while additional compartments are perfect for your phone, wallet, or keys. It’s your personal mobile command center, wherever the day takes you.

### Sit Back, Relax—Literally

When it’s time for a break, the SunStride Rollator transforms into a comfortable resting spot. The padded seat and backrest offer on-the-go comfort, making it easy to stop and sit wherever you are—at the park, in the kitchen, or waiting in line. And when you’re ready to move again, the ergonomic handles and responsive brakes help you get back on your feet safely.

### The Vive Difference: Comfort Meets Confidence

Every detail of the SunStride Rollator Walker is designed with the user in mind—from its height-adjustable handles for a custom fit, to its premium materials that combine durability with elegance. It's more than mobility—it's a lifestyle upgrade.

Whether you're recovering from surgery, living with a chronic condition, or simply want extra support on your daily walks, the SunStride Rollator by Vive is the dependable, stylish solution that helps you stay active, independent, and in control.
